meta.title: Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks: refused for a user without the Compliance Officer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and test Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks for a vendor email domain or PAN belonging to a group entity.
Repeat the same test as a Compliance Officer and compare whether the action is available or succeeds.
Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and record whether RBAC deliberately grants the capability to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and test Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks for a vendor email domain or PAN belonging to a group entity.; Repeat the same test as a Compliance Officer and compare whether the action is available or succeeds.; Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and record whether RBAC deliberately grants the capability to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as both the configured non-Compliance-Officer user and the Compliance Officer in the same Enterprise tenant, trigger Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks for vendor email-domain and PAN group-entity conflicts, and report whether the first user is refused or lacks the action while the Compliance Officer can perform it

steps.note: No catalog step can access the role-specific onboarding workflow or perform this RBAC comparison.
Confirm the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester completes or skips the unavailable workflow.
